messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 - routing anomaly detected in us-west-2. Elevated 5xx for hosted-tier requests. Incident created INC-2026-2201122333. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/routing-anomaly.

amber_oncall: Acked — taking lead. Paging eng-runtime and eng-platform.

jamal: Looking at routing logs now. Quick dump shows a wave of hosted tenant traffic being routed into dedicated pool id=42 for ~18m. Policy evals show `tier_match` returned false for lots of requests because `tenant_metadata.tier` is null for a subset of sessions.

mira: We rolled smart-routing v2 last night. Possible regression in the policy compiler or metadata enrichment path. Pulling last deploy.

casey: If we can’t patch fast, we should rollback routing policy to smart-v1. I can trigger a rollback if amber gives the thumbs.

amber_oncall: Do rollback. We need mitigation first to stop customer impact. Jamal, can you confirm correct target?

jamal: Confirmed. Rolling policy to smart-v1 now. Command:

```
redwoodctl routing policy rollback --env us-west-2 --from smart-v2 --to smart-v1 --force
```

Applying...

logs: "policy_apply: started id=INC-2026-2201122333"

ops-bot: Change requested: routing-policy rollback (smart-v2 -> smart-v1) by jamal. Approvals: auto.

ops-bot: Change applied: routing-policy rolled back to smart-v1 in us-west-2. status=success at 22:07:15 UTC.

amber_oncall: Observability update — error rate dropping fast. p50 latency back to normal; p99 still a bit high (gradual). Keep monitoring for cache warmup.

elena_support: Customer impact snapshot: 3 enterprise customers (anonymized: acct-23, acct-47, acct-98) experienced ~100% failed requests during window. Support has 4 open tickets and one escalation to AE. Drafting status page + customer note.

mira: Root-cause hypothesis: when tenant metadata is missing the new compiler produced a predicate that defaulted to excluding `hosted` (edge-case in expression simplifier). This caused the smart-router to evaluate requests as "unmatched" and fallback into dedicated buckets. Reproducer in dev: set tenant_metadata.tier=null and run policy-eval against smart-v2.

jamal: Quick mitigation patch ready: treat missing `tier` as `hosted` and hard-fail safe-route if metadata absent. I'm going to apply guard while we schedule a proper fix.

```
# temp guard (applied as hot-patch)
PATCH /routing/policies/smart-v2
body: {"defaults": {"tenant_metadata.tier": "hosted"}}
```

jamal: Hot-patch applied to smart-v2 in us-west-2 for safety. Observability shows no further misroutes in the last 3 minutes.

casey: Will open a follow-up PR to fix the compiler simplifier and add unit tests for missing metadata scenarios. Adding test vectors.

ryan_product: Need customer comms numbers for postmortem: total failed requests, duration, affected tenants, SLA hit estimate. Jamal/elena can you capture?

elena_support: Capturing now — roughly 6.1k failed requests across window, peak error rate 22% of region traffic for hosted tier. ETA for status post: 15m.

amber_oncall: Handoff: jamal owns the RCA and mitigation verification. I'll stay on-call for 30m to help with any rollbacks. Create incident tracking ticket and link runbook: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-2201122333.

ops-bot: Incident severity lowered to P2 at 22:25:00 UTC. Monitoring window started (1h).

jamal: Notes for postmortem: 1) regression in smart-routing v2 compiler simplifier for missing tenant metadata; 2) lack of safe default in policy engine; 3) insufficient test coverage for null metadata. Immediate fixes: rollback + hot-guard. Long term: compiler fix + test suite + telemetry to alert on metadata-null spikes.

elena_support: Status page posted and affected customers notified. AE team looped in.

amber_oncall: Closing thread for now — will update when RCA doc is attached. Thanks all for fast mitigation. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-2201122333 moved to postmortem state. Follow-up assignees: jamal (RCA), casey (compiler PR), mira (deploy validation), elena_support (customer comms)"
